search_files.desc: Find files or directories by name/path using glob patterns or Go regex. Use when you know part of a filename, extension, or relative path; use grep_files when you need to search file contents. Recursive searches default-prune common dependency/build directories such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, target, .next, __pycache__, and .venv unless you pass exclude_patterns explicitly.

params.path: Root directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory. Must be a directory.
params.pattern: Glob or regex pattern. Glob patterns without / match basenames; patterns with / or ** match relative paths.
params.max_results: Maximum matching paths to return. Default: 100. Non-positive values keep the default.
params.offset: Skip this many matching paths before rendering the page. Default: 0.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files/directories, including Windows hidden/system items. Default: false.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Regex patterns without / match basenames; regex patterns with / match relative paths. Default: false.
params.case_insensitive: Case-insensitive matching for glob or regex mode. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: Basename globs to prune before matching, such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, or generated files. If omitted, common dependency/build directories are pruned by default; pass an explicit empty array to disable that default set.
params.output_mode: "paths" (default) returns concise paths; "details" adds entry type, size, and modified time.
params.path_format: "relative" (default) returns paths relative to the search root; "absolute" returns absolute paths.
params.entry_type: "any" (default), "file", or "dir". Invalid values fall back to any.

grep_files.desc: Search text file contents for literal text or Go regex. Use output_mode=files_with_matches or count first for broad "where/how many" questions, and switch to content only when you need the actual lines. Binary files are skipped and reported. Recursive searches default-prune common dependency/build directories such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, target, .next, __pycache__, and .venv unless you pass exclude_patterns explicitly.

params.path: File or directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.pattern: Literal text by default, or a Go regular expression when use_regex=true. Required.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Required for regex operators such as |, ., *, +, ^, $, groups, or character classes. Default: false.
params.recursive: Search subdirectories when path is a directory. Default: true.
params.context_lines: Lines before and after each match in content/auto modes. Default: 0; maximum: 50.
params.max_results: Maximum matches per page for content/auto modes. In files_with_matches and count modes, this is the file-list page size. Default: 50. Non-positive values keep the default.
params.max_matches_per_file: Maximum matches to collect from any one file in content/auto mode. Default: 20; set 0 for unlimited. Lower values spread coverage across more files.
params.offset: Skip this many collected matches in content/auto modes for pagination. In files_with_matches and count modes, this skips that many matching files. Default: 0. Deep content pagination is capped; narrow with glob/exclude_patterns or switch to files_with_matches/count first.
params.glob: Only search files whose basename matches this glob, such as *.go or *.{ts,tsx}. Strongly prefer setting this in large projects.
params.output_mode: "auto" (default) shows matching lines when uncapped, then falls back to file list when capped; "content" always shows lines; "files_with_matches" returns paths; "count" returns per-file counts.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files and directories, including Windows hidden/system items. Default: false.
params.multiline: Allow matches to span lines. Uses full-file reads for eligible text files, so combine with glob/max_file_size on large trees. Default: false.
params.max_file_size: Skip files larger than this many bytes. Default: 0 (no size limit). When multiline=true and you omit it, grep_files applies a small safety cap to avoid whole-file reads on very large files.
params.exclude_patterns: Basename globs to prune before searching, such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, logs, or generated files. If omitted, common dependency/build directories are pruned by default; pass an explicit empty array to disable that default set.
params.path_format: "relative" (default) returns paths relative to the search root; "absolute" returns absolute paths.
